title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.89 (versions follow prime numbers), the tissues. In 0.83 a program was taken apart into gears (jump-free pieces it repeats) and every gear became a lens of Luma's eye. But the same gear is a different cell in each tissue it is expressed in. A tissue is anything of hers a gear can pass through; a cell is four letters in a recipe: E, two for the gear, one for the tissue. Six tissues are connected today (her looks, the frame she associates with, where her eye is, how it sees, where her pen is, where it heads) and the list is open: the remaining numbers do nothing yet and are free. Nobody assigns a gear to a tissue: each tissue has its own judge (reading or drawing, both in bits) and the cell that pays where it is expressed is the one that survives in her body. Measured on the New Testament with one gear of her own body (shift right by 8) in the same place of the champion recipe (14775): in her looks 15246, in the frame 8439, in her pen 14775 (it belongs to her body and does not touch reading); in her body the opposite holds (a form of 20 cells stays at 20 with a cell of her looks, becomes 21 with a cell of her pen, 16 with one of its heading). The heart is the kernel itself and is not connected yet. Stated limits: she has not yet placed a winning cell herself; opening a new tissue still means writing code. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.89: los tejidos — el mismo engranaje es otra célula según el tejido donde se expresa, y queda vivo donde paga. Prototipo de investigación.
